targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', occurred_at) AS time, 'failed_logon' AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM security_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND class_uid = 3002 AND activity_id = 5 AND ('$tenant_id' = 'all' OR tenant_id::text = '$tenant_id') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', occurred_at) AS time, 'logon' AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM security_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND class_uid = 3002 AND activity_id = 1 AND ('$tenant_id' = 'all' OR tenant_id::text = '$tenant_id') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', occurred_at) AS time, 'authz_denied' AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM security_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND class_uid = 3003 AND severity_id = 2 AND ('$tenant_id' = 'all' OR tenant_id::text = '$tenant_id') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(actor_user_uid, 'unknown') AS actor, count(*) AS denials FROM security_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND class_uid = 3003 AND severity_id = 2 AND ('$tenant_id' = 'all' OR tenant_id::text = '$tenant_id') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT date_trunc('hour', occurred_at) AS time, CASE WHEN class_uid = 3001 THEN 'account_change' ELSE 'api_key_change' END AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM security_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND class_uid IN (3001, 3004) AND ('$tenant_id' = 'all' OR tenant_id::text = '$tenant_id') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT bucket AS time, 'prompt_injection' AS metric, sum(checks) AS value FROM analytics.guardrail_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND direction = 'input' AND passed = FALSE AND ('$tenant_id' = 'all' OR tenant_id::text = '$tenant_id') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT bucket AS time, direction || CASE WHEN passed THEN '_passed' ELSE '_failed' END AS metric, sum(checks) AS value FROM analytics.guardrail_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND ('$tenant_id' = 'all' OR tenant_id::text = '$tenant_id') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
